Generate the finished screen artwork, no device mockup or border. Center a joyful minimal round-eyed robot face inspired by the reference: pale turquoise background, two dark charcoal circular eyes with tiny white highlights, a broad curved smile, warm orange cheek dots. Add a few crisp gold stars and turquoise/orange confetti around the face. Clean cheerful flat illustration readable at 280x240, large simple shapes, sharp dark contours, generous margins. Output composition aspect ratio 7:6, exactly 280x240 if supported.
face_sheet: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animation spritesheet for Robbi's 280x240 LCD. Reference image is the existing Robbi happy face and must be matched in identity: pale turquoise background, dark charcoal round eyes with white highlights, orange circular cheeks, a simple curved smile. Generate exactly TEN successive animation frames arranged in a STRICT regular grid of TWO columns and FIVE rows, no margins, no gutters, no outlines between cells, no labels, no text. Each cell is landscape 7:6; entire sheet aspect ratio 7:15. All faces centered at precisely identical positions and scale. Read order left-to-right then top-to-bottom. The 10-frame looping animation is a happy blink and tiny cheeky grin: frames 1-2 open smiling eyes; 3 eyes slightly squashed; 4 half closed; 5 closed happy crescent eyes; 6 half opening; 7 fully open; 8 right-eye wink; 9 right eye opening; 10 identical to frame 1. Subtle changes only, no robot body, no confetti, no perspective change. Uniform solid turquoise background across every cell. Clean crisp flat shapes readable at final 280x240 frame size. Output 560x1200 if supported. This is a precise sprite asset, not a collage or UI mockup.
